releases.name: ATTESA EVER SINCE Limited Edition
releases.dial: Deep blue gradient, forest-inspired pattern and moon-phase display
releases.description: ATTESA EVER SINCE limited edition inspired by a snow-covered forest at dawn. Calibre H874 combines light-powered Eco-Drive, radio-controlled timekeeping and a moon-phase display. The Super Titanium case and bracelet measure 41.5 mm across and 10.8 mm thick; sapphire crystal, 100 m water resistance. Planned global launch: November 2026. Singapore price and allocation are not confirmed.
releases.image_source: verified official model or release page

releases.name: CITIZEN Series 8 New Limited-edition Model with Damascus Steel and Forged Carbon
releases.description: Series 8 fifth-anniversary limited edition combining a Damascus-steel case centre with a forged-carbon dial. Automatic Calibre 9054 offers traveller GMT, approximately 50 hours of power reserve and enhanced magnetic resistance. The 41 mm case is 13.5 mm thick, with anti-reflective sapphire crystal, a transparent case back and 100 m water resistance. Planned global launch: October 2026. Singapore price and allocation are not confirmed.
releases.image_source: verified official model or release page

releases.name: The CITIZEN Two New Eco-Drive Tosa Washi Paper Models with Annual Accuracy of ±5 Seconds
releases.dial: White Tosa Unryushi washi paper with gold fibres
releases.description: The CITIZEN limited edition uses a Tosa Unryushi washi-paper dial with swirling fibres and gold accents, a Sakura Pink Super Titanium case and a crocodile-leather strap. Eco-Drive Calibre A060 offers annual accuracy of ±5 seconds and a perpetual calendar. The case measures 38.3 mm by 12.2 mm, with sapphire crystal and 100 m water resistance. The official Singapore product page lists S$4,578; confirm current availability with Citizen Singapore.
releases.image_source: verified official model or release page
